patches.name: Enhanced throw
patches.description: Installs the experimental native research loader for Pokémon GO 0.433.1 / 0.431.0 arm64-v8a.

patches.name: Google web sign-in
patches.description: Replaces Google Play Services sign-in with a browser-based Google login so Google accounts work in re-signed builds. Pokémon GO 0.433.1 / 0.431.0.

patches.name: Spoof signature (ROM support)
patches.description: Adds FAKE_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE and fake-signature metadata with Niantic's original certificate for ROMs/microG setups that support signature spoofing. Pokémon GO 0.431.0.
